classes.name: GeomToIGES_GeomCurve
classes.summary:
This class implements the transfer of the Curve Entity from Geom To IGES. These can be: Curve . BoundedCurve.
- BSplineCurve
- BezierCurve
- TrimmedCurve . Conic
- Circle
- Ellipse
- Hyperbloa
- Line
- Parabola . OffsetCurve

instanceMethods.comment: Transfer a GeometryEntity which answer True to the member : BRepToIGES::IsGeomCurve(Geometry). If this Entity could not be converted, this member returns a NullEntity.
